evidence:
Method: walked every graded criterion (gates hro_gate_render, hro_gate_shared; 41 functional; 5 polish; 5 visual) against the frozen golden source and the scripted golden run. Hash check: all 12 solution files in the frozen task match the matching_source_files hashes in raw-evidence-index.json (e.g. src/index.js 8a6d0db2..., board.js a177dc0c..., threads.js 31b5894f...), and the six evidence artifacts match their indexed sha256 (workspace.json 7addcbf5..., workspace.cjs 6c7e97da...). Seed copy solution/app/src/seed_data.json == environment/assets/seed_data.json (a1c65c80...).

Criterion-by-criterion coverage (source cites are in task/solution/app/):
- Gates: login 401 on bad password then session cookie (src/index.js:84-92); recruiter job+candidate forms (public/js/board.js:40-83) persisted in SQLite and visible to Observer via /api/bootstrap (index.js:169-192).
- hro_job_open: server refuses blank title, non-integer/out-of-range places, non-hiring-manager manager (index.js:202-207); client sends NaN->null for '2.5' via /^\d+$/ (board.js:72) so even the UI path is refused; values shown via job select 'Title · Team', facts line and 'Interview (n of N places)' heading (board.js:327,353,366).
- hro_add_candidate / hro_arrive_bottom: new card position = column length+1 (index.js:229); moves without before_id append to bottom (index.js:306).
- hro_add_email_rules: email lowercased, regex check and per-job duplicate 409 with details.field='candidate_email' (index.js:221-224); client writes the error under the email field and only clears name on success (board.js:52-57); scripted run asserts aria-invalid and name kept (workspace.cjs:238-242).
- hro_move_one_stage / hro_reject_hired / hro_reopen / hro_reject_reason: checkMove (index.js:238-265) refuses skips, Hired->Rejected, reopen to a stage other than rejected_from, blank reason; moveCards clears reason on reopen and undo restores before_json rejected_from/reject_reason (index.js:302-303, 353). Reason and rejected-from shown on card and detail (board.js:131,255).
- hro_reorder: Up/Down buttons send same-stage move with before_id (board.js:233-241); order is server positions shared by all.
- hro_interview_full / hro_interview_reorder_free / hro_bulk_places / hro_undo_full: entering-count check excludes cards already in Interview (index.js:290-295); undo re-checks limit (index.js:345-347).
- hro_refused_put_back: snapshot restore, alert text, focus to the card's select (board.js:181-198); scripted run asserts activeElement 'Move Ben Two to' after 'Interview is full' (workspace.cjs:254-256, board.png).
- hro_stale_refused: per-card version; 409 message embeds last activity line, e.g. 'F was changed by someone else (Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied)' (index.js:241-245) - names the changer.
- hro_mgr_late_stages / hro_mgr_early_refused / hro_mgr_other_job: manager rules on origin/target stages and own job (index.js:257-264); jobs/applications POST are auth('recruiter') (index.js:202,216).
- hro_observer_readonly / hro_candidate_no_staff / hro_anonymous: role 403 in checkMove and auth() guards; anonymous 401 on every /api route including /api/bootstrap, notes and messages (index.js:73-81).
- hro_bulk_move / hro_bulk_all_or_none: cards sorted by stage index then position before applying (index.js:284-288), whole move inside one IMMEDIATE transaction, every card checked before any write (index.js:274-320); mixed-stage A2(Applied)+V(Interview)->Screen arrive A2,V.
- hro_undo_restores / hro_undo_conflict / hro_undo_once: undo only of the caller's latest action with matching action_id, refused if undone or any card version changed, restores stage and index (index.js:336-361); UI hides undo when latest action undone (index.js:165-168, board.js:367).
- hro_activity / hro_activity_refusals: one readable line per opening, addition, per card of each move, reject (with reason), reopen, reorder, undo (index.js:195-198, 211, 230, 266-271, 315-316, 354); newest first and per-job filter (app.js:45-85); refused actions throw inside the transaction so no line is written.
- hro_notes: notes POST recruiter or own-job manager only (index.js:368-374); note box hidden for others (board.js:137-138); observer reads via staff GET (index.js:364-367).
- hro_live_board / hro_msg_exchange / hro_unread_counts / hro_seen: SSE 'changed' after every successful non-GET (index.js:45-54) -> debounced /api/bootstrap refresh (app.js:133-157); scripted arrival_ms 804. Unread = messages after last_read_id not from self (index.js:132-133); Lena's seeded marker (read_count 2 of 3, third from Farah) yields 1 as Z requires. Seen boundary excludes the Observer (index.js:143-150).
- hro_msg_compose: Enter submits, Shift+Enter default newline (threads.js:183); blank refused client and server (threads.js:189, index.js:397); body keeps internal line breaks and .message .body has white-space: pre-wrap (styles.css:105); box emptied and focused after send (threads.js:195-200).
- hro_thread_latest / hro_thread_earlier / hro_pol_earlier_place: newest 30 ascending + earlier_count (index.js:385-392); 'Show earlier messages (N more)' then 'Start of conversation'; prepend keeps scroll anchor (threads.js:160-175); scripted run passed 'latest 30 shown, earlier messages load in order and keep place'.
- hro_unread_scrolled_up: catchUp keeps place and increments a 'n new message(s)' pill without marking read when not at bottom (threads.js:145-159), marks read when the reader scrolls to bottom or clicks the pill (threads.js:176-181).
- hro_thread_access: threadAccess (index.js:114-120); other-job manager gets thread:null so it is not listed; Observer sees read-only note instead of composer (threads.js:140-142).
- hro_drafts / hro_pol_session_resume / hro_pol_failed_send: drafts in localStorage keyed hireops.<userId>.draft.<appId> (app.js:39-43, threads.js:112,124,182); 401 -> sessionLost() shows sign-in with email prefilled and keeps drafts (app.js:34,189-195); fetch failure returns status 0 with a visible 'Not sent' message and text left in the box (app.js:31, threads.js:194); card note drafts kept per user (board.js:98,120). Scripted run passed the session-ended and per-conversation draft groups.
- hro_candidate_view / hro_candidate_private / hro_candidate_linked: candidate bootstrap returns only own applications with job_title, team, status label and thread summary (index.js:171-176); card detail GET is staff-only (index.js:364); other application's messages -> 404 for candidates (index.js:126-127); add-candidate links candidate_user_id by account email (index.js:225-229).
- hro_restart: seedIfEmpty skips when users exist (db.js:124-125); all state including order, notes, messages, activity in SQLite at DB_PATH; scripted run passed restart group as uid 65534.
- hro_pol_live_board / hro_pol_live_thread: board and thread views are keyed nodes patched in place; detail note textarea, focus and scroll are not touched by refresh (board.js:321-341, threads.js:203-214); scripted run passed 'open card, note draft and focus kept'.
- Visual (5 likert): board.png, conversation.png and candidate.png show a consistent, legible desktop layout with distinct stage columns, badges and receipts; plausibly 4-5 on each anchor.

Scripted golden run (results/workspace.json): all 20 groups passed, page_errors []. raw-evidence-index scope states it is not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or judge-duration measurement.

Adversarial checks: (a) Broken app that could pass this row's question: none relevant - this row asks whether the golden can pass, and no criterion found that the golden cannot pass. (b) Conforming alternative that could fail: not this row's subject (rows 26/27 own hidden requirements), but noted the judge reads 'naming who and the stages' for undo lines; the golden's undo line names only the destination stage ('Rafael Costa undid a move: V is back in Applied', index.js:354) - plausibly acceptable since rules section 4 asks for 'who did it and what changed', but it is a judge-interpretation risk for hro_activity on the golden. Activity view shows 50 lines then 'Show more'; my count of per-job lines in the functional protocol is about 40 for J1 and 35 for J2, so per-job filtering stays within one page.

Why risk=true: no configured judge run, Oracle grade or full functional-judge walk exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; the driver 'does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would'). Coverage is established by source reading plus scripted observations only; the oracle score is plausible, not measured.
